specialist_request_planning.node_purpose: Each of six DELL specialists selects only its role-owned proposition requests before seeing answers.
specialist_request_planning.input_scale: One role-local objective, two or three request choices, company identity, as-of date and tool rules; no Evidence is prefed.
specialist_request_planning.schema_burden: Small strict request-selection tool over a role-local enum.
specialist_request_planning.materiality_and_quality_risk: High because omitting a role-owned demand, operating, value, cash, supply or counterevidence facet can bias the combined research conclusion.
specialist_request_planning.comparable_run_evidence: The natural DELL value-capture single-unit proved request selection and feedback-driven adaptation with the same current S1/S2 runtime; the six-role zero-call proof compiled thirteen non-overlapping facets.
specialist_request_planning.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max; tool_choice omitted because thinking-mode forced tool selection is unsupported.
specialist_request_planning.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Non-tool, empty, invalid or truncated output is a terminal role attempt; the role is not silently omitted and other independent roles may continue.

specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.node_purpose: Each specialist consumes exact EvidenceResponse and FeedbackReceipt objects and either selects a second bounded request round or stops with a justified PlanDelta and hypothesis-only GraphDelta.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.input_scale: At most two role-local rounds, at most three unique requests, reviewed excerpts capped by policy, typed NumericFacts, gaps and complete current-round feedback.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.schema_burden: Strict reflection, PlanDelta, GraphDelta and StopDecision surfaces with runtime-bound enums.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.materiality_and_quality_risk: Very high because a false sufficient stop, ignored failure receipt or promoted graph hypothesis would hide missing research or manufacture authority.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.comparable_run_evidence: The DELL single-unit R3-R7 sequence showed that feedback-domain equivalence and semantic repair are required; the current zero-call proof verified all thirteen role requests and checkpoint/resume behavior.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max for research reflection and plan change.
specialist_reflection_and_plan_delta.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Incomplete feedback coverage, unauthorized graph authority, invalid stop coverage or truncation fails the role closed and preserves the exact frontier.

specialist_workpaper_submission.node_purpose: Each specialist converts completed research and reflection into one role-local decision workpaper without expanding evidence authority.
specialist_workpaper_submission.input_scale: One lossless compact role view containing only that role's reviewed Evidence, NumericFacts, relations, gaps, method pack, graph context, reflections and stop decision.
specialist_workpaper_submission.schema_burden: Large strict workpaper tool with role-local Evidence, numeric, relation and gap enums.
specialist_workpaper_submission.materiality_and_quality_risk: Very high because unsupported causal attribution, cross-role leakage or disclaimer-heavy prose directly degrades the investment-research product.
specialist_workpaper_submission.comparable_run_evidence: The DELL value-capture max-thinking workpaper exhausted 13,922 of 16,000 reasoning tokens and truncated, while the qualified non-thinking submission completed the same bound contract.
specialist_workpaper_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled for contract submission; analysis is preserved in prior reflection artifacts.
specialist_workpaper_submission.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Truncated, unbound or out-of-role claims are terminal and remain available for Lead-routed repair rather than automatic rerun.

research_lead_coordination.node_purpose: Research Lead compares six validated specialist workpapers, routes only material role-local challenges and decides whether to evaluate, repair or pause for data/tool work.
research_lead_coordination.input_scale: Six bounded workpapers, their challenge catalog and no raw candidate pool; at most two coordination rounds.
research_lead_coordination.schema_burden: Strict coordination decision; Lead cannot author research facts, numbers or citations.
research_lead_coordination.materiality_and_quality_risk: Very high because false conflict resolution can erase valid dissent or let one role overwrite another role's authority.
research_lead_coordination.comparable_run_evidence: The earlier preview showed Lead/context capacity and one-shot coordination failures; the current zero-call successor proved challenge routing and post-repair recheck without fact-authoring.
research_lead_coordination.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max for cross-role comparison; tool_choice omitted.
research_lead_coordination.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Invalid or truncated Lead output preserves all six workpapers and stops at the Lead frontier; it never rewrites a specialist result locally.

role_local_repair_submission.node_purpose: A challenged specialist revises only feedback-affected judgment surfaces while preserving its prior Evidence, numeric, relation and gap authority sets.
role_local_repair_submission.input_scale: One prior role workpaper, one to three accepted cross-role FeedbackReceipts and the unchanged role-local authority view.
role_local_repair_submission.schema_burden: Same strict specialist workpaper contract plus immutable authority-set comparison.
role_local_repair_submission.materiality_and_quality_risk: High because a repair must correct overreach without smuggling in new facts or erasing material counterevidence.
role_local_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: The current zero-call repair successor changed only Value Capture, preserved all authority reference sets and returned to a separate Lead recheck.
role_local_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled for bounded resubmission; accepted feedback and prior analysis are explicit inputs.
role_local_repair_submission.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Authority-set drift, invalid refs or truncation fails the repair and preserves the prior valid workpaper.

owner_decision_basis: The owner authorized continuous execution after DELL S1/S2 readiness and a successful dynamic single-unit proof. The current clean zero-call chain now proves all thirteen role-owned requests, six isolated sessions, complete FeedbackReceipts, checkpoint/resume, Lead challenge routing and authority-preserving repair. One natural multi-agent live is the next unproven product behavior; fixed Pack or old preview results cannot substitute for it.
known_boundary: This authorizes one natural DELL dynamic multi-agent run over the current reviewed Evidence Pack and current S1/S2 runtime. It allows six independent specialists, at most two retrieval rounds per specialist, one or two Lead coordination rounds and no more than three role-local repairs. It forbids retries, external source acquisition, candidate promotion, public-gap self-authorization, product-pointer mutation, Writer execution, Workbench publication, S1/S3 acceptance, heterogeneous generalization and release. Every failed role or Lead frontier must be preserved and cannot be silently rerun.
